# HLS.js

`hls.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of hls.js 1.7.3 from the official npm package `hls.js`.

- Source: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/hls.js/-/hls.js-1.7.3.tgz
- Upstream copyright notice: `hls.LICENSE`
- License text: `APACHE-2.0.txt`

Used only to play CHZZK's own provided preview stream in the selected live-list card. No remote extension code is loaded.
